smoke.method: SQL functions under authenticated role; not HTTP end-to-end

limitations: No browser available in tool session: screenshots and real click-based visual QA are not completed.
No dedicated staging exists: million-row and 1000-1500 concurrent-user tests were not run.
Smoke checks execute SQL functions with authenticated role; they do not measure browser/network/REST latency.
No active OSC exists in current data; People OSC workflow is verified using rollback dummy fixtures.
Historical organization mappings use current assignments; missing historical status evidence is Unknown.
